passes.name: counts
passes.purpose: React commits, fibers and IndexedDB operations per store of one load (persisted, so the writes are counted too). Instrumented: no timing claims.

passes.name: pilot
passes.purpose: A short trial and a first look; plan.mjs adds a size pilot per timing workload before timing.

passes.name: h20
passes.purpose: The main verdict: a 500-tx history load, nothing persisted (remember false).

passes.name: ctl
passes.purpose: Paired control: 0 / 10 ms per page in ABBA order (k 10, warm-up 2: 4 pairs in whole 0 I I 0 blocks) must land in load CPU.

passes.name: persisted
passes.purpose: Negative control for persistence: a diff that does not touch storage drains the same on both sides (drain.persistMs, drain.taskCorrMs). When the diff touches storage, set remember true in every pass instead.

passes.name: more
passes.purpose: One more ABBA block of h20 when the advice says it could change a verdict.
